why: This is a reusable benchmark dataset of Korean Medical Licensing Examination questions, not a general instructional element.
name: KMLE 2022–2024 evaluation dataset of 942 Korean-language questions with physician-sourced images
product_description: A benchmark dataset of 942 Korean-language KMLE questions from 2022–2024, including text-only and physician-sourced image-based items across seven medical specialties, created by Kim Hyun Jin et al. for evaluating medical-knowledge language models.
